title: HP reports Q1 revenue up 6.9% YoY to $14.44B, vs. $13.94B est., and expects FY 2026 results to be at the low end of its forecasts; HPQ drops 6%+ after hours (Jaspreet Singh/Reuters)
summary: Jaspreet Singh / Reuters: HP reports Q1 revenue up 6.9% YoY to $14.44B, vs. $13.94B est., and expects FY 2026 results to be at the low end of its forecasts; HPQ drops 6%+ after hours — HP Inc (HPQ.N) said it expects fiscal 2026 results to be at the low end of its forecasts, as the personal computer maker grapples …
